description: This file defines functions, constants, and parsing/formatting rules related to week-year calculations in the Moment.js library, including formatting tokens, parsing tokens, and helper functions for ISO and locale-specific week-year handling.

methods.name: addWeekYearFormatToken
methods.description: Defines formatting tokens for week-year and ISO week-year.

methods.name: getSetWeekYear
methods.description: Gets or sets the week-year, considering locale-specific week start and first week day.

methods.name: getSetISOWeekYear
methods.description: Gets or sets the ISO week-year.

methods.name: getISOWeeksInYear
methods.description: Returns the number of ISO weeks in the current year.

methods.name: getWeeksInYear
methods.description: Returns the number of weeks in the current year based on locale settings.

methods.name: getSetWeekYearHelper
methods.description: Helper function to get or set the week-year with validation.

methods.name: setWeekAll
methods.description: Sets the date based on week-year, week, weekday, and locale-specific week start info.
